rules.accepted_credit_types: Only ACPE-accredited provider programs aimed at pharmacists (live or correspondence), plus Board-approved non-ACPE programs and approved child abuse courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: New graduates are exempt at the first renewal except for child abuse training; reciprocal licensees get 3.75 hours per remaining quarter.
rules.audit_note: Form submitted with renewal; random audit of 5% of renewals. Keep certificates 2 years; deficits must be made up within 6 months.

topics.who: All pharmacists: courses with ACPE topic designator 'Patient Safety'
All pharmacists: approved child abuse recognition and reporting courses
Pharmacists authorized to give injectables: injectable medications, biologicals and immunizations, within the 30

rules.notes: Licenses renew every 2 years in even-numbered years. Pharmacists authorized to give injectables must have 2 of the 30 hours on injectable medications, biologicals and immunizations.
